nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default Credentials Exploitation (CVE-related)
nodes.precondition: Network access (e.g., SSH, local console) to a Raspberry Pi device running Raspberry Pi OS up to version 5.10 with default 'pi' account credentials intact
nodes.postcondition: Attacker gains authenticated local access and administrative (sudo/root) privileges using default password 'raspberry'

nodes.label: piSignage Player API Path Traversal Arbitrary File Read (CVE-2021-38383)
nodes.precondition: Remote network access to piSignage player API (versions prior to 2.6.4) and authenticated as a low-privilege user
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file download and directory traversal via api/settings/log?file=../, exposing sensitive configurations, authentication tokens, and system files from the Raspberry Pi

nodes.label: RaspAP includes/webconsole.php Unrestricted Command Execution (CVE-2021-33357)
nodes.precondition: Authenticated access to RaspAP 2.5 web interface (e.g., via credentials obtained from system files or default configurations)
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary operating system command execution, arbitrary file upload, and execution of arbitrary code on the underlying Raspberry Pi OS

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Optical Power-LED Side-Channel Audio Recovery (Glowworm Attack)
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B device through 2021-08-09 powering audio-output equipment (speakers) playing sound, with optical line-of-sight to the power indicator LED
nodes.postcondition: Remote interception and reconstruction of speech and acoustic signals played through speakers via optical analysis using a telescope and electro-optical sensor

nodes.label: Oculus Browser Remote HTML Injection and UI Spoofing
nodes.precondition: Victim navigates to an attacker-controlled remote web page using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11)
nodes.postcondition: Injection of arbitrary HTML into the Oculus Browser UI, enabling UI spoofing and potential remote code execution in the context of the unprivileged local browser process

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hard Link Arbitrary File Write Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local unprivileged execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop prior to version 1.44.0.32849
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file write with elevated privileges via hard link to log files, resulting in local privilege escalation to SYSTEM

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Handle Leak Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local unprivileged process execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop versions between 1.39 and 31.1.0.67.507
nodes.postcondition: Exposure of privileged process handle from OVRServiceLauncher.exe to unprivileged process, leading to local privilege escalation to elevated system context

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Configuration Physical DMA Attack
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged attacker with physical access to NVIDIA Jetson Linux board via the PCI bus
nodes.postcondition: Direct read/write access to the entire physical address space via PCIe DMA, enabling complete kernel memory tampering, arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, denial of service, and compromised cross-component security scope
